end.summary: Practised showing that sums of consecutive odd numbers starting at 1 form square numbers.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised using dot patterns and repeated addition to connect odd-number sums with square numbers. They correctly found 1+3+...+13 = 49 and identified 1+3+... through 23 as 144. Saanvi mixed up the rule by including odd-number runs that do not start at 1; this was not corrected by the end (correctAfterLastSeen: 0). At home, ask them to check whether an odd-number sum starts at 1 before deciding it is a square, then practise triangular-number pairs such as 10+15.
